    • removeCardTypeRefFromProject

      public void removeCardTypeRefFromProject(Long cardTypeId, Long projectId)
      Remove the card type use of the project. That means delete the reference in the project if it has no usage. If the abstract card type is used, throws an error.
      Parameters:
      cardTypeId - the id of the card type reference no more useful for the project
      projectId - the id of the project in which we don't want to use the card type anymore
